text: Commit hygiene: always stage, then review 'git diff --cached --name-status' in a separate step, then commit. On 2026-09-26 a previously 'git rm'-staged file (server/ai-proxy.ts) was swept into an unrelated commit (cd7ab30) because staging+stat+commit ran in one command. Candidate deterministic control: a pre-commit hook or ops.mjs commit helper that refuses to commit when staged paths fall outside the declared cluster path set.

scripts/naming/technical-naming-census.mjs isPtProse() requires a raw score >=2 before flagging a comment/test-title as Portuguese prose. This let at least 21 real Portuguese test titles (describe/it in apps/api and apps/web, e.g. "AdminDashboard — falha de query nunca vira KPI zerado fabricado") pass --check as testTitle candidates:0 because they contained only one weak PT_PROSE function word (e.g. only 'nunca') and no PT_TOKENS lexicon noun and no accented character. Found via a manual second-pass broad regex scan during Cluster Zero Z4 closure (mission-a5c14661), not by the tool itself. Recommend: add a PT_STRONG entry for common unmarked verbs already seen in the wild (executa, grava, registra, atualiza, verifica, confirma, concede, popula, produz) and/or lower the prose threshold specifically for describe/it/test string arguments (shorter, higher-precision strings than free-form comments) so a single unambiguous PT verb is sufficient.

completion-gate.mjs / gate-engine.mjs's workspaceFingerprint appears to bind to something that changes on every commit (likely includes HEAD or the ops state.json content itself), so PASS evidence captured and committed together always reads as 'stale or failing' again immediately after that very commit lands (observed mission-a5c14661, Cluster Zero Z1-Z5 closure 2026-09-27: re-verified+committed at HEAD 1fab009, then the ops-state-only commit 7c6b959 that recorded that evidence made the gate report all 5 criteria stale again, even though zero source files changed between the two commits). This creates an unavoidable one-commit lag between 'genuinely fresh evidence' and 'gate agrees it's fresh' for any criterion whose evidence is committed alongside itself. Recommend: exclude .claude/ops/** from the fingerprint's tracked-tree hash (evidence/state bookkeeping isn't product code under test), or fingerprint working-tree content only (not HEAD), so recording evidence doesn't retroactively invalidate itself.
